en: A black-and-white photograph showing a person in period attire (likely late 19th or early 20th century) walking alone on a winding path through a landscaped park or garden. The path is bordered by trees and grassy slopes. In the background, there are large buildings that appear to be spa hotels or sanatoriums nestled on the hills. On one prominent building, the text 'KALTSPRING' and 'CAFÉ RESTAURANT' is visible. The backdrop is a hilly or mountainous landscape, and a monument or tower is visible at the summit of one hill.
